title: Kid Safe Music Videos Helping Build Emotional Intelligence with Bible Stories, Bible Songs, and Bible Nursery Rhymes | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
Positive Peer Learning Software Group is revolutionizing early education for kids and helping parents with their positive, informational, educational, inspirational, musical Bible stories and Bible nursery rhymes. The animated videos for two-year-olds to ages 11, feature biblical stories with music to sing along for empowering the faith of children. The Bible Kids EI channel on YouTube provides lessons about God, God’s love, Jesus Songs and stories, Christian and Judaic values and emotional intelligence. “We love helping children and parents inspire and grow their faith,” said Sandra Clifton, co-founder of The Smart Brain Train Academy. “Our aim is to help parents and kids looking for safe videos with morals and avoid brain rot of many secular videos shown on YouTube. Parents and Bible Sunday School teachers will like the kid safe learning channel with Beginner Bible Stories in HD videos, Bible Bedtime stories from Genesis to Jesus to Revelation that builds faith, morals, and emotional intelligence. Positive Peers Learning Software collaborates with Smart Brain Train Academy, the world’s first media company to feature Bible nursery rhymes, Biblical musical stories,and Bible study curriculums with animated children’s Christian and Judaic music. The videos also integrate emotional intelligence to help children learn self-regulation, mindfulness, empathy, and self-control.
Kids Bible EI channel provides educational and entertaining Judaic and Christian faith-friendly Bible content. Parents will find that it is free, safe, kid-friendly, and appropriate video content and music. The channel was founded to help parents find good Bible videos that teach Bible stories and theology for kids that are less than five “Positive Peers Learning Software Group is the first to provide HD animated musical Bible nursery rhymes and beginner Bible stories for kids with emotional intelligence for young children ages 2 and up,” said Jomo Gamal Thomas, co-founder of Positive Peers Learning Software Group.
“The goal is to help and inspire young children as well as neurodivergent learners to be able to learn and grow their faith with Bible songs and stories in a fun and safe way,” said Sandra Clifton, co-founder of Positive Peers Learning Software Group. “Christian parents now have a safe platform on YouTube that also allows kids to sing along while being inspirational and informational with wholesome, faith-based content.”
“Christian parents are searching for Bible stories for kids entertainment that they can trust, said Sandra Clifton. “Our biblical stories and animated Bible songs align with positive Christian and Judaic values and capture their children’s attention to enrich their faith.” Parents and kids love our Bible-based music videos such as Jesus Resurrection, Jesus Feeds the 5000, Jonah and the Whale, Moses and the 10 Commandments, and David and Goliath.”
“We create safe educational, informational, and inspirational videos, nursery rhymes, Bible stories for kids, bedtime stories, and songs with emotional intelligence for preschoolers and elementary school kids,” said Sandra Clifton, co-founder of Positive Peers Learning Software Group. “We are the pioneers of learning that integrates emotional intelligence for kids as well as neurodivergent learners.”
Positive Peers Learning Software is the leader in education and emotional intelligence for young children, homeschoolers, neurodivergent, Christian, and Judaic. They are known for their apps, books, and animated videos.
Check the official YouTube Channel of Positive Peers Software Learning Group:: https://youtube.com/@kidsbible-ei
Bible Kids EI channel by Positive Peers Learning Software Group is a safe channel for kids and is helpful to parents that want to teach and have their children values based on the Bible. Sandra Clifton and Jomo Gamal Thomas created the content inspired by parents who were concerned about having healthy Christian and Judaic children’s videos.
The animated HD Bible cartoons are dedicated to creating uplifting and educational content, and they are the first media company to have animated Jesus Nursery Rhymes, Easter Bible Nursery Rhymes, Moses, David, and Goliath.
Positive Peers Learning Software Group was founded by Sandra Clifton and Jomo Gamal Thomas of the award-winning New Testament Bible for Kids, My First Jewish Bible for Kids, Bible, EQ and IQ Academy 10 in 1 Workbook for Preschool, Kindergarten, and Neurodivergent Learners. Workbook.
The Bible cartoon stories are based on the Literary Titan Award Children’s Bible by Jomo Gamal Thomas and Sandra Clifton with contributions by Jomo Jesus Thomas Suriel.
Learn more at: https://positivepeerslearning.com
